newsitem.title: USA: Clinton signs MFN bill for Cambodia.
newsitem.headline: Clinton signs MFN bill for Cambodia.

text.p: President Bill Clinton on Wednesday signed a bill granting Cambodia Most Favoured Nation (MFN) trading privileges, declaring it would aid efforts to establish democracy and economic reform in the Southeast Asian nation.
"I believe MFN status will make an important contribution to achieving our policy goals for a peaceful, prosperous and free Cambodia," Clinton said in a written statement.
MFN cuts taxes on hundreds of exports and enables countries to compete on a level playing field in trade with the United States. It also expands opportunities for U.S. business and investment.

"My approval of this legislation reflects the strong U.S. support for the people of Cambodia in their efforts to overcome a tragic past and establish a democracy based on human rights and market economy reforms," Clinton said.
